column1: # Mod jars: direct GL11 matrix calls. The game always goes through
# GlStateManager (redirected to GLMatrix in redirects-opt.tsv); a mod
# that calls GL11 directly would change the driver's matrix behind the Java stack,
# and the next glLoadMatrixf from GLMatrix would undo what it did. Here those
# calls go to the same stack. LWJGL 2 names (those of the mod jar); these
# rules come after the name mapping and replace it on the same keys.
# Lists called in bulk (the game only uses glCallList): the driver needs the pending matrix.
# Fixed-function pipeline called directly by mods (the game never calls these): through SteinCoreGl, which forwards to the driver in the
# usual context and, in the core profile of the Stein renderer, does not call what the driver lacks (calling it would abort the JVM).
